evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present \textbf{OpenDGO}, a controlled benchmark and analysis framework covering six real-world domains and three collaboration settings: Sequential Dependency, Parallel Decomposition, and Information Integration.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Existing studies typically adopt predefined organizations, such as Star, Chain, and Tree, or learn communication graphs to improve performance on specific tasks.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Under matched tasks, agents, tools, and resource limits, OpenDGO compares fixed and learned organizations while separately examining communication graphs, role assignments, input assignments, resource budgets, and component failures.
